title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude in Chrome moved from pilot to general availability on all paid Claude plans, enabling Claude to view and act on websites without direct integrations. Autonomous action approval for safe tasks and enhanced three-layer security (adversarial training, content screening, automatic verification) reduce strong prompt-injection attack success from 3.8% to 0%.

title: What 1,000 small business owners taught us about AI
summary: Anthropic's Claude SMB Tour trained 1,000+ small business owners across 10 US cities, following launch of Claude for Small Business with QuickBooks and PayPal integrations. Research found non-technical owners can build custom tools, accuracy and data security dominate adoption barriers, hands-on practice drives engagement, and peer stories matter more than features.

title: T. Rowe Price brings more of Claude to its investment process
summary: T. Rowe Price expanded Claude across portfolio management, research, and tool development, with analysts using Claude Cowork for research synthesis and developers using Claude Code to build investment tools. The firm prioritized deploying Claude with core decision-makers rather than back-office functions while maintaining human judgment and accountability.

title: Claude for Teachers, now available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts
summary: Claude for Teachers expanded from individual educators to a free enterprise offering for qualifying US K-12 schools and districts, adding centralized management (single sign-on, role-based access, domain claiming) and state-standards-aligned teaching skills. FERPA-aligned terms ensure student data is not used for model training.

title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
summary: Claude Cowork now includes a built-in, isolated browser enabling Claude to navigate websites and complete web tasks independently without needing access to the user's personal browser, addressing privacy concerns. Users can delegate web tasks like filling forms and pulling dashboard data while continuing other work. Rolling out this week to Pro, Max, and Team plans.

title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Anthropic's internal case studies show Claude Tag (bringing Claude into Slack conversations) accelerating workflows across teams: marketing synthesized discussions 60x faster, product ops compiled feedback in hours versus a week, and legal teams cut review time from a day to 30 minutes. The approach delegates research and synthesis to Claude while preserving human judgment for final decisions.
